`ieee-manuscript-edit`, and engineering proposal delivery goes first to

replacements.after: This local fork handles general English prose. Chinese prose, IEEE or SCI manuscript delivery, and engineering proposal delivery belong to their respective language- or domain-specific writing workflows. Resolve writing-router, ieee-manuscript-edit, or project-writing by name through the host's available skills when present; sibling directories are not assumed. When absent, use the host's applicable writing or document workflow without claiming to have invoked a missing skill. Those formal delivery workflows own terminology, evidence, and register, so this skill must not add personality or first-person claims to their final text.
